    {"name": "wall_motion_index", "event": "echocardiogram", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "wall_motion_score", "event": "echocardiogram", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "mult", "event": "echocardiogram (derived)", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.8},

    {"name": "epss", "event": "echocardiogram", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "group", "event": "heart attack or earlier (e.g., treatment assignment)", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.9},
